notes.title: First big update
notes.notes:
Dear friends we are happy to announce a major update on our game!

- Whole game balance been drastically reworked:
Now it's easier to win (where it's meant to be), adequate difficulty in late game. Less pain - more fun!
- Completely reworked UI and text
Now it's easier and more understandable to manage your crew, the description of game elements became better
- Added main menu
Familiar menu to everyone
- New music
It's two times more music tracks. Now you won't get bored
- Fixed known bugs 
Fixed some errors and issues from the latest builds

notes.title: Balance change
notes.notes: We reworked the difficulty, now you can always repair the ship

notes.title: Chinese is finally here
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35069079/74e58ee78c6abcf5c2466d4e16d63d99d908f8d4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35069079/c50510c9603662a564179f907fdd23111df67d4c.jpg[/img][/url]

Another milestone achieved as toR studio never stops working. 
Chinese has been one of our main goals as we want to have our game translated for as many languages as we can. 
A lot of work was done translating it to English and Chinese, a bit of work awaits as we are almost ready with the other languages. 
Black Baron and toR studio want you to be with us :)

notes.title: Just a week!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35069079/1e52b4d9317033ec8c3998248402b48c0efe8099.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35069079/7ec2eff791d09f1feda76162be4da3c95967056d.jpg[/img][/url]


Only a week remains untill the release of Black Baron. 

Complecety and micromanagment are the key features of our game.
The further you go, the stronger the enemies are.

Choose a right crew and [b]gun set against every enemy[/b].
During the battle, don't forget about ammo and crew health. And don't let your enemies on board.
Guess enemy sectors by watching enemy crew's pathing.

Win! Find Black Baron!
